elements.label: Table B2
elements.title: List of Common R Statistical Commands
elements.details:
| R Command       | Result                          |
|-----------------|--------------------------------|
| mean()          | Calculates the arithmetic mean |
| median()        | Calculates the median           |
| min()           | Calculates the minimum value    |
| max()           | Calculates the maximum value    |
| weighted.mean() | Calculates the weighted mean   |
elements.summary: This table lists common R statistical commands along with their descriptions, useful for data analysis in R.
